method: Computed margin, padding, gap and inset of every rendered element, over 140 probe runs covering screen states, viewports and modes. Phase B is compared with the Phase A state (9dec2e2, numeric utilities reading tokens). Each reading is classified as a token-based change or a layout-derived change. A box counts as changed when its width or height moves by more than 1px. Dialogs were not opened.

A.result: Zero of 465,722 elements changed padding, margin or gap.

B.probe_state: Probe run before four fixes: search field pe-8, mobile page gutter kept at px-2.5, email compact density at 6px, sign-in Change min-width 44px on coarse pointers. The probe was not re-run on the final state.

open: Notification menu clipped at 390px is pre-existing and tracked in #47; its 52 off-screen readings are content inside that menu.
Plain CSS spacing literals (383 off-scale px values) are not covered by this measurement or by #25.
